run_linear_probe_training: run linear probe training on a pre-trained MAE ViT model for image classification
run_linear_probe_evaluation: run evaluation only mode to test a linear probe model on validation images
run_distributed_linear_probe: run distributed linear probe training across multiple GPUs with gradient accumulation
run_linear_probe_resume: resume linear probe training from a saved checkpoint at a specific epoch
run_linear_probe_with_global_pool: run linear probe training using global pooling instead of class token for classification
